## Why PracticeRank Exists

The way patients find dentists has fundamentally changed. 90% of patients search online before booking. Over 40% now ask AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok for recommendations. 60% of local dental search clicks go to the Google Maps 3-pack. Traditional SEO agencies only optimize for Google — and they charge $5,000-$10,000/month for it. PracticeRank optimizes across every platform patients use, for less than half the cost.

"Most dental practices are completely invisible in AI search results. They're spending thousands on agencies that only optimize for Google — while 40% of patients are asking AI for recommendations and getting sent to a competitor." — Kody Doherty, Founder
